input.summary: Insert Subparagraph 18.8 requiring the other Parties to give Teleglobe 90 days' transition assistance and to export its data within 30 days of expiry or termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 18 deals only with realization of assets and residual liabilities, so we have added a short exit clause: on expiry or termination (including of our participation) the other Parties provide at least 90 days of transition assistance and export our data within 30 days. This is our fallback position; we would otherwise ask for six months' assistance at then-current rates with certified deletion.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, or of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in this Agreement, the other Parties shall (a) at Teleglobe USA Inc.'s request, provide transition assistance for a period of not less than ninety (90) days; and (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Teleglobe USA Inc. all data and records belonging to, supplied by or processed for Teleglobe USA Inc. under this Agreement.
